sloka: पुरा भूत्वा मृदुः दांतः सर्व भूत हिते रतः ।न क्रोध वशम् आपन्नः प्रकृतिम् हातुम् अर्हसि ॥३-६५-४॥
transliteration: purā bhūtvā mṛduḥ dāṁtaḥ sarva bhūta hite rataḥ ।na krodha vaśam āpannaḥ prakṛtim hātum arhasi ॥3-65-4॥

translations.english: Earlier you were gentle, self restrained and engaged in the welfare of all beings. (Now) it is not proper for you to give up your natural composure in anger.
